in_hebrew.name: Herby
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Honor, fame, bright
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Herby הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek, Herby derives from Heros, meaning 'honor' or 'reputation.' In a biblical context, Herby could be associated with the Hebrew word heru, meaning 'bright' or 'shining,' which is a reference to the glory of God.

in_latin.name: Herby
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen masculinum significans 'herba, herbis similis' - origo a nomine 'herba' derivata, significans 'herbaceus, herbis similis'. Utilitatum in cultu Christianorum, nomen Herby adhibetur propter symbolum spiritualis regenerationis, qua homo renascitur in novo homine Christo. Historia et significatio nominis Herby in cultura Christiana pertractabitur in tractatu de nomen Christianorum
